name: weapon-foundry-graft-transaction

validation_order.rule: requesting player currently owns/controls target and donor interaction is valid
donor actually contains requested row in the requested property kind
target weapon row is present in compatibility_matrix.properties[row_id].production_weapons
no existing target row appears in compatibility_matrix.properties[row_id].transferable_conflicts
duplicate row is absent unless compatibility_matrix duplicate_status is explicitly supported
ordinary affix count remains below native quality-scaled cap 0/3/4/5/6 for color bytes 0..4
weapon_mod graft requires the single native secondary-fire slot to be empty unless multi-mod behavior is later verified

cost.charge_timing: after all validation and immediately before mutation inside the authoritative transaction

commit_order: mutate target through native weapon-affix/skill storage
verify target reports new row and resolved context rebuild succeeds
rollback: if target mutation fails: refund Power Cells; donor remains
if target verification fails: revert target mutation when native API permits; refund Power Cells; donor remains
donor is never consumed before target mutation verifies

idempotency.rule: server rejects a previously committed transaction key

multiplayer_requirements: host/server validates donor contents and target legality
all modded peers converge on target weapon state before donor disappears

rule_engine.donor_identity_usage: server re-enumerates live donor affix instances and reconciles enchanted/chassis-native lookalikes before donor_contains_row validation

ui_preview.rule: UI may preview cost/legality but server recomputes from authoritative weapon/currency state before commit
